Reasoning & planning

QA3 constructs solutions through proofs

An extended resolution procedure used proofs to construct solutions to formally described problems.

Cordell Green

AI topics

Explore related entries. Larger tags appear on more entries.

ReasoningPlanningLogicSymbolic AI

The contribution

Green connected theorem proving with finding an object or action sequence that satisfies a goal. QA3 used explicit descriptions of states and transformations, with demonstrations including small planning problems and simple program construction. This treated a proof as a route to a concrete solution, not just a yes-or-no answer.

What this does not establish

The examples required carefully specified axioms and restricted domains. They did not demonstrate reliable planning in an open, changing real-world environment.

Why this date?

1969 dates the IJCAI paper. The linked archive copy identifies itself as a preliminary version; SHRDLU reference 19 cites the conference work.
